Name: Country Windows for Dynamic Windows
Author: Breelier
Description:
This mod adds a collection of farmhouse and cottage-style windows.
This mod is a Content Patcher content pack and requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35690]Dynamic Windows[/url] to function.

[line]

[size=4][b]🌟 Key Features[/b][/size]

[quote]💡 [b]About the showcase below:[/b]
[list]
[*]Interactive windows, seasonal wildlife, and weather effects are provided by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35690]Dynamic Windows[/url] framework. See the original mod page for the full feature list.[/*]
[*]Not all windows are openable; the GIFs below showcase the openable variants.[/*]
[/list][/quote]
[size=3][b]1. Interactive Windows[/b][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/43639012-1782814632.gif[/img]

[size=3][b]2. Spring Butterflies[/b][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/43639012-1782814590.gif[/img]

[size=3][b]3. Winter Snow[/b][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/43639012-1782814653.gif[/img]

[line]

[size=4][b]🎨 Color Variants[/b][/size]

Since version 1.2.0, Country Windows includes a base pack with 5 optional color variants. Install only the colors you want:

[list]
[*][b]Black & White[/b] [i](base pack)[/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Walnut[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Oak[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Birch[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Winter[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Mahogany[/b][/i][/*]
[/list][i]
Don't want a particular color in your Furniture Catalogue? Simply delete its subfolder.
[/i]
[line]
[i]
[size=4][b]🛠️ Installation[/b][/size]

[b]Requirements:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] + [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35690]Dynamic Windows[/url]
[/i]
[list=1]
[*][i][b]Updating from an older version?[/b] Delete your old [i][DW] Country Windows[/i] folder first.[/i][/*]
[*][i]Download and unzip this mod, then place the [i][DW] Country Windows[/i] folder directly into your [i]Mods[/i] folder.[/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Country Windows[/b] is required. The 5 color packs are optional — delete any color subfolders you don't want to use.[/i][/*]
[/list][i]
All installed windows will appear in the [b]Furniture Catalogue[/b].

[size=3][b]⚙️ In-Game Configuration[/b][/size]

Open [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] and go to:

[b]Dynamic Windows → Background Style → [color=#ffff00]Country Windows[/color][/b][/i]
